The '''Small Crystal''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|750}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}. It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Players who select a [[Farm Maps|Hill-top farm map]] during character creation will have one inside their house when the game begins.

There is a small chance to receive this furniture item from slaying [[monsters]], breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], chopping [[trees]], shaking trees with seeds, digging [[Artifact Spot]]s, or [[Pans|panning]].<ref name="rarecosmeticdrop" />
